TASK: Among users who registered on Yelp in 2016, which 5 business categories have received the most total reviews from those users since 2016?

ANSWER (top 5 categories by total review count):
1. Restaurants - 58 reviews
2. Food - 38 reviews
3. American (New) - 24 reviews
4. Shopping - 20 reviews
5. Breakfast & Brunch - 19 reviews

(Next closest, for reference: Automotive 17, Local Services 17, American (Traditional) 16)

METHODOLOGY:
1. user_database (DuckDB): identified 168 users whose yelping_since contains "2016" (registration year 2016, across mixed date formats).
2. Joined those users to the review table, yielding 150 reviews. Extracted each review's year via regex ((19|20)\d{2}) to handle mixed date formats; all 150 reviews were dated 2016 or later, so all satisfy the "since 2016" condition.
3. businessinfo_database (MongoDB): pulled business_id and description for all 100 businesses. Categories are embedded in the description text (e.g., "...services including Nail Salons, Hair Removal, Beauty & Spas, and Waxing"). Built a category vocabulary from capitalized phrases recurring across >=2 business descriptions (excluding address/state tokens), then matched categories per business with case-insensitive, word-boundary, longest-first non-overlapping matching.
4. Mapped review.business_ref ("businessref_N") to business.business_id ("businessid_N") - all 150 reviews matched a business - and counted each review once toward every category of the reviewed business.
5. Ranked categories by total review count. The top 5 are robust: every reviewed business had its categories extracted, and any single-occurrence category could contribute at most 8 reviews (the max reviews of any single business), far below the #5 count of 19.
